description: Shopify store products API for AI agents: send a store's domain and get up to 250 of its public products as JSON: title, vendor, product type, price range, compare-at price, sale and availability flags, tags, image, description and variants with SKU and price. A site that is not a Shopify store, or has no public products, is not charged; products you paid for but did not get are refunded. Pay per call in stablecoins.

limit.description: number of products wanted, 1 to 250 (default 20). A larger value is lowered to 250 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

store.description: the store's domain, e.g. "example.com" (an https URL of the bare domain is accepted too; no port, path or IP address)

name: shopify-products
title: Public products of a Shopify store
